fichas.title: Railway tracks
fichas.summary: Reference sheet covering railway clearance envelopes, track-centre spacing, rail profiles, gauges and sleeper lifetimes, drainage, longitudinal gradients, wheel loads, and standard track-bed cross-sections for single- and double-track lines.
